text: The dataset that detected the 2021 tree-cover loss is the Hansen/UMD Global Forest Change version GFC-2025-v1.13. This dataset mapped approximately 81.3 hectares of tree-cover loss within the asset during that year. The detection was corroborated using the JRC Global Forest Cover 2020 reference map, which agreed on 98% of the event area. The tree-cover loss was observed in a planted forest context, specifically Pinus elliottii and Pinus taeda species.
